entities.summary: Michael Polanyi was a Hungarian-British polymath, who made important theoretical contributions to physical chemistry, economics, and philosophy. He argued that positivism is a false account of knowing. Michael Polanyi was a performers & entertainers from Budapest (1891-03-11, Budapest–1976-02-22). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
